scope: one approved export batch from the Harbor Archive staging workspace

requirements.text: Remove direct personal identifiers before the export package leaves the staging workspace.
Keep the consent source register separate from the exported package.
Require approval from both the Records Lead and the Data Steward when a category is not listed in the batch request.
Write the batch identifier and approval references to the export audit record.
After the receiving team confirms arrival, delete the temporary package from the staging workspace and record a deletion acknowledgement.
Escalate an approval dispute to the Records Lead within two working days.

explicitly_unspecified: the maximum retention period after receipt
the retry procedure when arrival confirmation is absent
the technical encryption profile for transfer
